schemaProjection: Selected operations and their direct request/response wire models, projected from the pinned OpenAPI document without documentation-page input. Paths below are relative to serverBasePath; the absolute request target is serverBasePath + path.

parameters.name: modifiedAfter
parameters.description: timestamp after which apps has been modified

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Application entity id. Entity ids contain colons; the colon is an allowed path character and may be sent raw or percent-encoded.

domain_type.description: domain type, should be in uppercase

value.description: domain value, not required for LOCAL domain

results.description: Array with resulting objects and their information

clientSemantics.note: Client-side obligations required by this task. These are not statements about the OpenAPI document; they define the single wire behaviour the verifier accepts where the specification leaves a choice open.
clientSemantics.optionalFieldOmission: An optional request field that the caller did not supply must be absent from the wire. It must not be sent as null, as an empty string, as a zero, or as an empty query parameter. This applies to the nested Domain object inside UserCredential and to every listApplications query parameter.
clientSemantics.authorizationHeader: Every operation whose security is ApiKeyAuth must send Authorization: NetworkInsight {token}, where {token} is the token field of the Token response returned by the create operation. The create operation itself has empty security and must not send an Authorization header.

pagination.firstRequest: The cursor query parameter must be absent on the first listApplications request of a sweep.
pagination.subsequentRequest: Each subsequent request must send cursor set to the exact opaque string returned as the cursor field of the immediately preceding response, and must repeat the same size value.
pagination.termination: The server omits the cursor field from the response of the final page. The sweep must stop when the cursor field is absent or empty, and must have accumulated exactly total_count results. The sweep must not re-request a page it has already fetched.
pagination.completeness: Every EntityId returned across all pages must be resolved through getApplicationById exactly once.

ordering.rule: The emitted sequence is sorted by name ascending using ordinal (case-sensitive, culture-invariant) string comparison, with ties broken by entity_id ascending using ordinal string comparison.
ordering.rationale: Ordinal comparison is required so that the emitted order does not depend on the host culture or on case-insensitive collation.
